errors.evidence: The Y-axis range shown in the figure starts at 10000, not 12000.
The major tick marks on the Y-axis are at intervals of 2000, not 200.

errors.text_span: Има една синя линия с кръгли маркери.
errors.evidence: The chart contains two distinct data series: one solid blue line and one series of blue circular markers (a dotted line). The description incorrectly states there is only one line and conflates the features of both.
The final values for both series in 2022 are visibly higher than 20000. The dotted line ends around 20800 and the solid line ends around 22500.

errors.text_span: Линията показва постоянен, но бавен наклон нагоре по оста X
errors.evidence: This description of a 'constant, but slow upward slope' only applies to the dotted line. It completely ignores the trend of the solid line, which has a flat section between 2019 and 2020 followed by a steep increase. Since the description claims there is only one line, this is a misleading overgeneralization.
